source: GAMINGbible: How to get Fortnite's Pirate Shop Token (Nov 2, 2026)
text:
If found, the Pirate Shop Token allows a player to claim every single cosmetic item from the Item Shop for free, so you can see why players are desperate to get their hands on it.
Yes. Surprisingly, the Pirate Shop Token is shared among duos, trios, and squads. That means that if one player in a group finds it, all players within that group will get the reward of 28 days free shop access.
If you're lucky enough to find the Pirate Shop Token, you get a whopping 28 days of free access to Fortnite's Item Shop, split into two 14-day chunks.
A second 14-day window is then due to unlock sometime in 2027, so you get another two weeks to hoover up every item in the constantly-changing line-up.
Battle pass levels and rewards are excluded from the offer, and there is a limitation on sidekicks with players only able to claim one for free that they do not already own.
Once you've found the coin, return to the item shop, where you'll be met with the option to "Plunder the Item Shop". Select "Activate Now" and your free 14-day 2026 access will begin.
You do have to claim everything in the item shop, so don't expect things to automatically land in your account during that 14-day period.
